message.content: The sea’s hue varies widely—most often it appears **blue** (from water absorbing longer wavelengths) or **turquoise/greenish‑teal** when shallow waters mix sunlight with algae or sand. In deep oceanic zones it tends toward darker indigo, while near coastlines you might see lighter blues or even greenish tints from reflected vegetation. So “the color” depends on depth, angle of light, and surrounding environment!
